name: measure
description: A measure with its ISO/IEC/IEEE 15939 metadata: information need, consumer, base or derived, function, decision criterion. Read from what defines it (the SLOs of config/registry/slo.json, the measure of each validation, the cheaper-path measure of D-327). It is not conformant while it is proposed (no function wired), lacks an information need, a consumer or a decision criterion, or is not fresh: no value on HEAD (a validation in state defined; an SLO, whose forge event log HEAD does not hold).
